features.name: RevolvingUtilizationOfUnsecuredLines
features.description: Total balance on credit cards and personal lines of credit divided by the sum of credit limits.

features.name: age
features.description: Age of the borrower in years. Must be >= 18.

features.name: NumberOfTime30-59DaysPastDueNotWorse
features.description: Number of times 30-59 days past due in the last 2 years.

features.name: DebtRatio
features.description: Monthly debt payments (alimony, living costs) divided by monthly gross income.

features.name: MonthlyIncome
features.description: Monthly gross income in USD. Null values are accepted and imputed with the training median.

features.name: NumberOfOpenCreditLinesAndLoans
features.description: Number of open loans and lines of credit.

features.name: NumberOfTimes90DaysLate
features.description: Number of times 90 or more days past due.

features.name: NumberRealEstateLoansOrLines
features.description: Number of mortgage and real estate loans including home equity lines of credit.

features.name: NumberOfTime60-89DaysPastDueNotWorse
features.description: Number of times 60-89 days past due in the last 2 years.

features.name: NumberOfDependents
features.description: Number of dependents in the household, excluding the borrower. Null values are accepted and imputed with 0.
